mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.exam_id, r.knowledge_point, r.question_count, r.ratio, r.single_ratio, r.sort_no, r.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM question q WHERE q.deleted = 0 AND q.bank_id = e.bank_id AND q.knowledge_point = r.knowledge_point) AS available_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM question q WHERE q.deleted = 0 AND q.bank_id = e.bank_id AND q.qtype = 'SINGLE' AND q.knowledge_point = r.knowledge_point) AS available_single FROM exam_knowledge_rule r LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id WHERE r.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY r.sort_no, r.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO exam_knowledge_rule (exam_id, knowledge_point, question_count, ratio, single_ratio, sort_no, create_time) VALUES
(#{it.examId}, #{it.knowledgePoint}, #{it.questionCount}, #{it.ratio}, #{it.singleRatio}, #{it.sortNo}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(q.knowledge_point, '未分类') AS knowledgePoint, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.qtype = 'SINGLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS singleCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.qtype = 'MULTI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.qtype = 'JUDGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS judgeCount FROM question q WHERE q.deleted = 0 AND q.bank_id = #{bankId} GROUP BY IFNULL(q.knowledge_point, '未分类') ORDER BY totalCount DESC, knowledgePoint

SELECT p.id, p.exam_id, p.user_id, p.create_time, u.nick_name AS user_name, pos.position_name, u.user_status FROM exam_participant p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN position pos ON pos.id = u.position_id WHERE p.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT user_id FROM exam_participant WHERE exam_id = #{examId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO exam_participant (exam_id, user_id, create_time) VALUES
(#{it.examId}, #{it.userId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS examId, e.exam_name AS examName, e.bank_id AS bankId, e.single_count AS singleCount, e.multi_count AS multiCount, e.judge_count AS judgeCount, e.single_score AS singleScore, e.multi_score AS multiScore, e.judge_score AS judgeScore, e.question_count AS questionCount, e.duration AS duration, e.pass_line AS passLine FROM exam e WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.exam_mode = 'PRACTICE' AND e.exam_type = 'THEORY' AND e.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND e.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY e.published_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1
